description:
Large midline posterior fossa mass.

Secondary non-communicating obstructive hydrocephalus.

Mass shows heterogeneous increased T2 signal with areas of susceptibility weighted artefact representing areas of hemorrhage. Heterogeneous contrast enhancement.

Marked diffusion restriction. External ventricular drain in situ.

Right parafalcine T2 hypointense lesion with hyperintense rim.
